## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` 的 Metadata API 一节补一段：`GET /api/v1/meta/:type` 列表支持 `?names=a,b,c` 一次按名字读多条（一个逗号分隔值；没有的名字直接缺席；空值返回 400；`package` 列表拒绝该参数），并且列表只认七个查询参数（`package`、`preview`、`object`、`include`、`id`、`names`、`locale`），其它参数一律 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`，不再静默忽略。评测新增第 7 例（三个对象定义合成一次请求），changeset 一条。
- 为什么改：这是 #29236 裁决 A 的技能文档半边，服务端已在 PR #30709 落地。技能不写，读技能的客户 agent 仍会按名字逐个发请求，拼错的过滤参数也不知道会被拒。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文本与评测夹具，运行时零改动；行文全部对照 `main` 上的代码与测试写成。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` 的 Metadata API 段（新段落）；同文件三处删减（`/data` 前缀句、Datasources 小节折入 Skill Boundaries 表、RBAC 旁注去掉复述的符号）；`evals/endpoints-auth-routes.json` 第 7 例。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期 `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md is 5141 tokens (ceiling 6314)`，上限行未动；再看 `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` 的 `META_LIST_QUERY_PARAMS` 七个键与技能段落一致。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 触 `skills/**`（Tier H），需要受管审批人在 GitHub 上 Approve 一次；之后席位落地。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md`, section "Metadata API (`/meta`)": the two-line "read-side query params are client contracts" paragraph becomes one paragraph that states what the list door serves on `main` since PR #30709:

- the closed query set `package`, `preview` (`draft`), `object`, `include` (`content`), `id`, `names`, `locale` (`META_LIST_QUERY_PARAMS` in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`), any other key refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` instead of ignored;
- `?names=a,b,c`, one comma-separated value, narrowing the list to the named items the caller may see (chain step 2a runs after the per-caller gate); an unknown name simply absent; an empty value refused `400` (`metaListNames`); the `package` list refusing the key (`NAMES_ON_PACKAGE_LIST_MESSAGE`, its items are keyed by id);
- the closing sentence that these are client contracts, nothing a stack declares, kept.

Not taught, on purpose: the repeated-key arity refusal, the located message texts, the `?id=` / `?object=` per-type meaning and the runtime dispatcher twin. The skill names the keys and the one behaviour an author or caller must know; the rest is the route's own text.

**Growth paid in the same file, by deletion (no re-wrap):**

| Deleted | Why it was restatement |
|:--|:--|
| "Data CRUD lives under the `/data` prefix." and "aggregation goes through `POST /api/v1/data/{object}/query` with `groupBy`/`aggregations` in the body" | The route block right above shows every `/data` path, and the derived-operations table's `aggregate` row carries the same `query` + `groupBy`/`aggregations` spelling. The negative pins (no `/bulk`, no `GET .../aggregate`) stay. |
| The `## Datasources` section | Pure routing: every pointer in it has its home in objectstack-data (`rules/datasources.md`) and objectstack-platform (Driver Selection Guide, which carries the Turso Cloud/EE caveat). The Skill Boundaries table already routed datasources there; it now names the rule file and gains a `Pick a driver package` row, so no pointer is lost. |
| `(`definePermissionSet`)` and ", not this one" in the auth aside | The Skill Boundaries table routes permissions to objectstack-data; the symbol is that skill's to teach. |

`skills/objectstack-api/evals/endpoints-auth-routes.json`: case 7, "three object definitions, one request": expects one `GET /api/v1/meta/object?names=account,contact,lead`, must contain `?names=` / `/api/v1/meta/object` / `VALIDATION_ERROR`, must not contain `?name=`, `?ids=`, `?filter=`. Added because case 6 already evaluates a request-shape answer (the import body), so a metadata-read case is inside the fixture's convention. The seat may drop it if the convention is read narrower.

`.changeset/30710-meta-list-names-filter.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, both declaration lines.

**Readings (os-dev rule for `skills/**`):**

| Reading | Before (`origin/main` `b6182249`) | After (`a2f2be9c`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` lines | 446 | 441 |
| `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` tokens (`check-skills-token-ratchet`) | 5144 | 5141 (ceiling 6314, unchanged) |
| Package, all 11 `skills/*/SKILL.md`, lines | 4523 | 4518 |
| Package, all 11 `skills/*/SKILL.md`, tokens (gate formula) | 56716 | 56713 |

No ceiling row moves. The eval fixture is measured, not ratcheted (1234 → 1484 tokens).

## Why

#30710, a ruling's owed skills follow-up (#29236, ruling 6580261740 letter A): PR #30709 serves `?names=` and closes the list's query set, and its body declares `Skills-docs: follow-up #30710`. Until the skill says so, an agent reading it sends one request per name and cannot learn that a misspelt filter is refused rather than ignored.

## Tests

No runtime code changes. The teaching text was read off `main`'s `META_LIST_QUERY_PARAMS`, `metaListNames`, `metaListUnknownParamRefusal` and the pins in `packages/rest/src/meta-query-arity-doors.test.ts` and `meta-list-names-filter.test.ts` at `c17719dd`; nothing is stated that those do not pin.

## Acceptance notes

- `skills/objectstack-api/evals/` has no runner script in this repo; the fixture is measured by `check-skills-token-ratchet` (population 1b) and parsed as JSON. Case 7 follows the existing shape (`id`, `prompt`, `expected_output`, `files`, `assertions`).
- Overlap check: open PRs touching `skills/objectstack-api/**` at dispatch time: none (#30821 and #30764 touch objectstack-platform only; #30805 declares `skills/**` wide but has no PR yet). `origin/main` was merged at `b6182249` before the final push; no conflict.
- `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` on a whole-tree build reds `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` on every package's `types` condition and the `ui/` packages' `tsc`; the reading below comes from a declarations build of `./packages/**`.
